# tGBP developers

> tGBP is Tokenised GBP, a British pound stablecoin backed one to one by cash and cash equivalents and issued by BCP Technologies Ltd. This site documents @tgbp/kit, the open-source TypeScript kit for tGBP on EVM chains and Solana and for the tGBP API.

tGBP has 18 decimals on EVM chains and 9 on Solana. Test tGBP on Base Sepolia has no value.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dev.tokenisedgbp.com/): what tGBP is, the kit's modules including the API client, the API reference and the developer community.
- [Quickstart](https://dev.tokenisedgbp.com/quickstart): from a clean machine to a confirmed test tGBP transfer on Base Sepolia.
- [Describe tGBP accurately](https://dev.tokenisedgbp.com/brand): the name, the claims to make and the claims to avoid.

## Code

- [@tgbp/kit README](https://github.com/bcp-markets/tgbp-devkit#readme): every helper and error code.
- [Quickstart scripts](https://github.com/bcp-markets/tgbp-devkit/tree/main/examples/quickstart): the files the quickstart uses.
